sources.quote: HD 148427, formally named Timir, is a 7th-magnitude star approximately 230 light-years away in the constellation Ophiuchus.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 8.501 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,940 K, so 3.986 solar radii.
